instant.$description: 0ms instant state change. Reduced-motion standard and non-animated toggles.

fast.$description: 150ms micro-interaction duration for button hover, active press, and icon rotations

normal.$description: 250ms standard transition duration for dropdown menus, popovers, and card expansions

slow.$description: 350ms macro transition duration for modal dialog entries, slide-in drawers, and page changes

standard.$description: Signature MDS natural easing curve (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)) for standard on-screen transitions

enter.$description: Deceleration easing curve (cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)) for elements appearing on-screen

exit.$description: Acceleration easing curve (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)) for elements disappearing off-screen
